description: Oscillator with six waveforms, hard sync and a full ADSR envelope and VCA built in

params.text: Chooses the waveform: sine, triangle, inverted saw, square, saw morphing to inverted saw, or sine morphing to saw
Tunes the oscillator over half an octave either way
Lifts the oscillator by three octaves while it is lit
Adds an oscillator an octave below the main one while it is lit
Switches the FM input between linear and exponential response; exponential while it is lit
Sets the pulse width of the square wave, or the blend point of the two morphing waveforms, and does nothing to the other three
Scales the shape CV input, -100% to 100%, so that below zero the CV is inverted
Scales the FM input, -100% to 100%, so that below zero the modulation is inverted
Sets how long the envelope takes to rise to full, 1ms to 15 seconds
Sets how long the envelope takes to fall from full to the sustain level, 1ms to 15 seconds
Sets the level the envelope holds at while the gate stays high, 0% to 100%
Sets how long the envelope takes to fall to silence once the gate closes, 1ms to 15 seconds
Holds the envelope open for as long as it is lit, whatever the gate input is doing
Turns the envelope into a free-running cycle of attack and release, skipping the decay stage, once a gate has arrived or Hold is lit; the sustain knob then sets how high it climbs

inputs.text: Sets the pitch, 1V per octave with 0V giving C4
Modulates the frequency, linearly or exponentially as the FM mode button is set, scaled by the FM amount knob
Modulates the shape knob, scaled by the shape CV knob
A rising edge here sets the oscillator's phase back to the start, which hard-syncs it to whatever is patched
Opens the envelope while it is high, and is ignored while Hold is lit or a cable is patched to the envelope input
Replaces the envelope entirely while a cable is patched here, along with the gate input and the Hold button; 0-10V, so another module's envelope output drives this one

outputs.text: The oscillator with the envelope applied to its level
The envelope currently shaping the audio output, 0-10V
The oscillator's raw phase ramp, -5V to 5V and untouched by the envelope; patch it into another oscillator's sync input to lock the two together

notes: the module's channel count follows whichever of its CV inputs carries the most channels, including the envelope input.
